fields.title_en: From KarSU to professional growth
fields.summary_uz: Universitetda shakllangan bilim, intizom va hamjamiyat kuchining kasbiy yo‘lga ta’siri haqida hikoya.
fields.summary_en: A story about how university knowledge, discipline and community shape a professional journey.
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Imkoniyatni kutmang: bilimni amaliyot bilan mustahkamlang va professional aloqalarni bugundan boshlang.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Do not wait for opportunity: apply your knowledge and start building professional relationships today.

fields.title_en: From technical ownership to team leadership
fields.summary_uz: Kichik loyiha uchun mas’uliyat olish qanday qilib tizimli fikrlash va jamoa yetakchiligiga yo‘l ochgani haqida.
fields.summary_en: How ownership of a small project became a path toward systems thinking and team leadership.
fields.hero_image_alt: Texnik mas’uliyatdan jamoa yetakchiligigacha hikoyasi uchun professional ish muhiti
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Talabalarga tavsiyasi: kichik loyiha bo‘lsa ham, natija uchun to‘liq mas’uliyat olishni mashq qiling.
fields.student_takeaway_en: His advice to students is to practise full ownership, even when the project itself is small.

fields.title_en: From numbers to better decisions
fields.summary_uz: Moliyaviy hisobotdan tashqariga chiqib, tahlilni rahbariyat uchun amaliy qarorga aylantirish tajribasi.
fields.summary_en: A journey from preparing reports to turning analysis into practical decisions for leaders.
fields.hero_image_alt: Raqamlardan asoslangan qarorlargacha hikoyasi uchun professional ish muhiti
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Talabalarga tavsiyasi: jadval tuzish bilan cheklanmay, raqam nimani o‘zgartirishi kerakligini ham ayting.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Her advice is not to stop at the spreadsheet: explain what the numbers should change.

fields.title_en: From clear writing to trusted media
fields.summary_uz: Tahririyat intizomi va auditoriyani tinglash professional media yo‘nalishini qanday shakllantirgani haqida.
fields.summary_en: How editorial discipline and listening to audiences shaped a professional media path.
fields.hero_image_alt: Aniq matndan ishonchli mediagacha hikoyasi uchun professional ish muhiti
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Uning tavsiyasi: yaxshi matn avval tinglashdan, keyin yozishdan boshlanadi.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Her advice is simple: strong writing begins with listening before drafting.

fields.title_en: Turning experience into practical teaching
fields.summary_uz: Sinfdagi kuzatuvlar qanday qilib o‘qituvchilar uchun sodda va foydali metodikaga aylangani haqida.
fields.summary_en: How classroom observations became simple, useful methods for practising teachers.
fields.hero_image_alt: Tajribani amaliy metodikaga aylantirish hikoyasi uchun professional ish muhiti
fields.student_takeaway_uz: Talabalarga tavsiyasi: nazariyani eslab qolishdan oldin uni qayerda sinashingizni aniqlang.
fields.student_takeaway_en: Her advice is to decide where you will test a theory before trying to memorise it.

fields.content_uz: QarDUdagi ta’lim jarayoni nazariy bilim bilan birga mustaqil fikrlash, mas’uliyat va jamoada ishlash ko‘nikmalarini shakllantirdi.
Kasbiy yo‘ldagi muhim qadam bilimni real vazifalarda sinab ko‘rish va tajribali mutaxassislar bilan aloqa o‘rnatishdan boshlandi.
Har bir loyiha, amaliyot va uchrashuvni o‘sish imkoniyati deb qabul qiling. Izchil harakat kichik qadamlarni katta natijaga aylantiradi.
Universitet yillarida Azizbek algoritm va dasturlashni faqat fan sifatida emas, muammoni bosqichma-bosqich yechish usuli sifatida o‘rgandi.
fields.content_en: At university, Azizbek learned to see algorithms not only as a subject but as a disciplined way to solve problems.

fields.content_uz: Bitiruvdan keyin u kichik texnik jamoada qo‘llab-quvvatlash va ichki vositalar yaratish bilan ish boshladi.
fields.content_en: After graduation, he started in a small technical team, supporting systems and building internal tools.

fields.content_uz: Ikkinchi yilida kechikayotgan loyihaning texnik rejasini qayta tuzish vazifasini olishi uning burilish nuqtasi bo‘ldi.
fields.content_en: His turning point came in his second year when he was asked to rebuild the plan for a delayed project.

fields.content_uz: U vazifalarni kichik relizlarga ajratib, jamoa ichidagi kod ko‘rib chiqish jarayonini yo‘lga qo‘ydi.
fields.content_en: He split the work into smaller releases and introduced a consistent peer-review routine.

fields.content_uz: Bugun u muhandislik qarorlarida tezlik bilan birga barqarorlik va tushunarli kommunikatsiyani ustuvor deb biladi.
fields.content_en: Today he values reliability and clear communication as highly as delivery speed.

fields.content_uz: Dilnoza universitetda moliya bilan birga statistika va taqdimot ko‘nikmalariga alohida e’tibor berdi.
fields.content_en: Dilnoza gave equal attention to finance, statistics and presentation skills at university.

fields.content_uz: Faoliyatining dastlabki bosqichida u muntazam hisobotlar tayyorlar, ammo natijalarning qarorlarga ta’siri cheklanganini sezardi.
fields.content_en: Early in her career she prepared regular reports but saw that they had limited influence on decisions.

fields.content_uz: Bir budjet loyihasida xarajatlar sababini bo‘limlar kesimida tushuntirib berishi unga yangi mas’uliyat olib keldi.
fields.content_en: A budget assignment changed that when she clearly explained the drivers behind costs across departments.

fields.content_uz: Shundan so‘ng u hisobotlarni savol, dalil va tavsiya shaklida qurishni odat qildi.
fields.content_en: She then began structuring every analysis around a question, evidence and a practical recommendation.

fields.content_uz: Hozir u yosh tahlilchilarga aniqlik, manba sifati va xulosaning amaliy qiymatini birgalikda baholashni o‘rgatadi.
fields.content_en: Today she teaches junior analysts to evaluate clarity, source quality and decision value together.

fields.content_uz: Madina filologiya ta’limida matnning ohangi, dalili va o‘quvchiga ta’sirini bir butun ko‘rishni o‘rgandi.
fields.content_en: Madina learned to consider tone, evidence and reader impact as one editorial responsibility.

fields.content_uz: U dastlab ta’limiy materiallarni tahrirlash va qisqa axborot matnlarini tayyorlash bilan shug‘ullandi.
fields.content_en: She began by editing educational materials and producing concise information pieces.

fields.content_uz: Auditoriya savollari asosida bir ruknni qayta qurishi uning ish uslubidagi muhim burilish bo‘ldi.
fields.content_en: Her turning point came when audience questions led her to redesign an entire content series.

fields.content_uz: Jamoa mavzularni avval foydalanuvchi ehtiyoji bilan tekshirib, so‘ng format va kanalni tanlay boshladi.
fields.content_en: The team started validating topics against user needs before choosing format and channel.

fields.content_uz: Bugun Madina tahririyat sifatini tezkorlikdan ustun qo‘ymaydi, aksincha ikkalasini aniq jarayon bilan uyg‘unlashtiradi.
fields.content_en: Today she balances editorial quality and speed through a clear, repeatable process.

fields.content_uz: Nargiza talabalik davridayoq nazariya bilan amaliy kuzatuv o‘rtasidagi farqni qayd etib borardi.
fields.content_en: Nargiza noticed the gap between theory and observation while she was still a student.

fields.content_uz: Faoliyatini o‘qituvchilikdan boshlab, har bir mashg‘ulotdan keyin qisqa refleksiya yozishni odat qildi.
fields.content_en: She began as a teacher and developed a habit of writing a short reflection after each lesson.

fields.content_uz: Bir guruh o‘qituvchilar bilan dars tahlili o‘tkazishi bu qaydlarni tizimli metodikaga aylantirishga turtki berdi.
fields.content_en: A collaborative lesson review prompted her to turn those notes into a repeatable method.

fields.content_uz: U murakkab tavsiyalar o‘rniga sinab ko‘rish mumkin bo‘lgan kichik pedagogik qadamlarni taklif qildi.
fields.content_en: Instead of abstract guidance, she proposed small teaching practices that colleagues could test immediately.

fields.content_uz: Hozir u dasturlarni o‘qituvchining kundalik sharoitiga mosligi bilan baholaydi.
fields.content_en: Today she judges programmes by how well they fit the realities of a teacher’s working day.

fields.title_en: Analytical thinking as a professional language
fields.intro_uz: Amaliy matematika, murakkab savollar va tushunarli xulosalar haqida suhbat.
fields.intro_en: A conversation about applied mathematics, difficult questions and clear conclusions.
fields.pull_quote_en: A precise question is half of a good analysis.

fields.title_en: Why listening matters in public programmes
fields.intro_uz: Hududiy loyihalarda reja, muloqot va javobgarlik haqida suhbat.
fields.intro_en: A conversation about planning, dialogue and accountability in regional programmes.
fields.pull_quote_uz: Yechim hujjatda emas, odamlar bilan suhbatda aniqlashadi.
fields.pull_quote_en: Solutions become clearer in conversation, not only in documents.

fields.title_en: Moving from student life into a career
fields.intro_uz: Ko‘nikmalar, tajriba va birinchi professional qadamlar haqida suhbat.
fields.intro_en: A conversation about skills, experience and the first professional steps.
fields.pull_quote_uz: Ishga tayyorlik diplomdan oldin, odatlardan boshlanadi.
fields.pull_quote_en: Career readiness begins with habits before it begins with a diploma.

fields.question_en: What did your education at KarSU give you?
fields.answer_uz: Menga masalani modelga aylantirish va taxminni dalildan ajratishni berdi. Bu odat har qanday sohadagi tahlilda foydali.
fields.answer_en: It taught me to turn a problem into a model and separate assumptions from evidence. That discipline is useful in any analytical field.

fields.question_uz: Professional yo‘lingizdagi eng muhim qaror qaysi bo‘lgan?
fields.question_en: What was the most important decision in your professional journey?
fields.answer_uz: Faqat hisoblash emas, natijani oddiy tilda tushuntirishni o‘rganishga qaror qilganim muhim bo‘lgan.
fields.answer_en: Choosing to explain results in plain language, not only calculate them, changed my career direction.

fields.answer_uz: Noaniq topshiriqlarda to‘g‘ri savolni topish eng katta qiyinchilik edi. Vaqt o‘tishi bilan savolni aniqlash ishning asosiy qismi ekanini bildim.
fields.answer_en: The hardest part was finding the right question in an ambiguous brief. I learned that defining the question is a substantial part of the work.

fields.question_uz: Talabalar qaysi ko‘nikmaga ko‘proq e’tibor berishi kerak?
fields.question_en: Which skill deserves more attention from students?
fields.answer_uz: Mantiqiy fikrlash bilan birga yozma kommunikatsiyaga. Yaxshi xulosa tushunarli bo‘lmasa, uning qiymati kamayadi.
fields.answer_en: Students should pair logical thinking with written communication. A strong result loses value when it cannot be understood.

fields.question_en: What advice would you give students today?
fields.answer_uz: Kichik ma’lumotlar to‘plamida ham sifatli savol va toza metod bilan ishlang. Ko‘lam keyin keladi.
fields.answer_en: Work carefully with small datasets and clear methods. Scale can come later.

fields.question_en: What did your education at KarSU give you?
fields.answer_uz: Tarixiy jarayonlarni sabab va manfaatlar bilan ko‘rishni o‘rgandim. Bu jamoat loyihalarida shoshilinch xulosadan saqlaydi.
fields.answer_en: It taught me to examine processes through causes, interests and context. That prevents rushed conclusions in public programmes.

fields.question_uz: Professional yo‘lingizdagi eng muhim qaror qaysi bo‘lgan?
fields.question_en: What was the most important decision in your professional journey?
fields.answer_uz: Rejani kabinetda yakunlamasdan, avval manfaatdor tomonlar bilan tekshirishga o‘tganim eng muhim qaror edi.
fields.answer_en: My most important decision was to test plans with stakeholders before finalising them at a desk.

fields.answer_uz: Turli guruhlarning kutishlarini bitta aniq maqsad atrofida birlashtirish qiyin bo‘lgan. Bunda muntazam muloqot yordam berdi.
fields.answer_en: Bringing different expectations around one practical goal was difficult. Regular, respectful communication made it possible.

fields.question_uz: Talabalar qaysi ko‘nikmaga ko‘proq e’tibor berishi kerak?
fields.question_en: Which skill deserves more attention from students?
fields.answer_uz: Tinglash va qisqa, aniq qayd yuritishga. Eshitilgan fikr hujjatga va keyingi harakatga aylanishi kerak.
fields.answer_en: Students should practise listening and concise documentation. What is heard must become a record and a next step.

fields.question_en: What advice would you give students today?
fields.answer_uz: Odamlar bilan ishlashni alohida ko‘nikma deb biling. Hurmatli muloqot ko‘p texnik xatolarning oldini oladi.
fields.answer_en: Treat working with people as a professional skill in its own right. Respectful dialogue prevents many technical mistakes.

fields.question_en: What did your education at KarSU give you?
fields.answer_uz: Ta’lim menga o‘rganish jarayonini kuzatish va odamning ehtiyojini tushunishni berdi. Bu dastur tuzishda juda muhim.
fields.answer_en: My education helped me observe how people learn and understand their needs. That perspective is essential when designing programmes.

fields.question_uz: Professional yo‘lingizdagi eng muhim qaror qaysi bo‘lgan?
fields.question_en: What was the most important decision in your professional journey?
fields.answer_uz: Bir vaqtning o‘zida ko‘p yo‘nalish ortidan ketmasdan, bitta ko‘nikmani amaliy loyiha bilan chuqurlashtirishga qaror qildim.
fields.answer_en: I stopped chasing many directions at once and chose to deepen one skill through a real project.

fields.answer_uz: Tajriba yetishmasligini yashirish istagi qiyin bo‘lgan. Savol berish va fikr-mulohaza so‘rash tezroq o‘sishga yordam berdi.
fields.answer_en: The temptation to hide inexperience was difficult. Asking questions and requesting feedback helped me progress faster.

fields.question_uz: Talabalar qaysi ko‘nikmaga ko‘proq e’tibor berishi kerak?
fields.question_en: Which skill deserves more attention from students?
fields.answer_uz: O‘zini boshqarish va taqdimot ko‘nikmasiga. Bilimni muddat, natija va auditoriya bilan bog‘lash kerak.
fields.answer_en: Self-management and presentation deserve more attention. Knowledge needs to connect with deadlines, outcomes and audiences.

fields.question_en: What advice would you give students today?
fields.answer_uz: Har semestr yakunida bitta ko‘rinadigan natija yarating: loyiha, tadqiqot yoki yaxshi hujjatlashtirilgan amaliyot.
fields.answer_en: Finish each semester with one visible result: a project, a research note or a well-documented practical experience.

fields.title_en: Start ownership with a small project
fields.content_uz: Kichik vazifa bo‘lsa ham, maqsad, muddat va natijani o‘zingiz kuzating. Mas’uliyat odati keyingi katta imkoniyatlarga tayyorlaydi.
fields.content_en: Even on a small assignment, track the goal, deadline and outcome yourself. The habit of ownership prepares you for larger opportunities.

fields.title_en: Find the question behind the number
fields.content_uz: Formulani bilish yetarli emas. Har bir hisob nimani tushuntirishi va qaysi qarorga yordam berishini yozib ko‘ring.
fields.content_en: Knowing the formula is not enough. Write down what each calculation explains and which decision it should support.

fields.title_en: Make the conclusion simple
fields.content_uz: Murakkab tahlilning qiymati uning tushunarli xulosasida. Natijani soha mutaxassisi bo‘lmagan odamga ham izohlashni mashq qiling.
fields.content_en: The value of complex analysis lies in a clear conclusion. Practise explaining the result to someone outside your field.

fields.title_en: Listen before you write
fields.content_uz: Yaxshi matn faqat uslubdan iborat emas. Auditoriya savolini tinglang, manbani tekshiring va keyin eng kerakli fikrni yozing.
fields.content_en: Good writing is more than style. Listen to the audience’s question, verify the source and then write what matters most.

fields.title_en: Document the agreement
fields.content_uz: Uchrashuvdan keyin mas’ul shaxs, muddat va keyingi qadamni qisqa yozib yuboring. Bu ishonch va hamkorlikni mustahkamlaydi.
fields.content_en: After a meeting, record the owner, deadline and next step. This simple habit strengthens trust and collaboration.

fields.title_en: Test theory through a small experiment
fields.content_uz: Yangi metodni birdan mukammal qilishga urinmang. Uni bitta mashg‘ulotda sinab, kuzatuv yozing va keyingi safar yaxshilang.
fields.content_en: Do not try to perfect a new method immediately. Test it in one session, note what happened and improve it next time.

fields.title_en: Turn feedback into a routine
fields.content_uz: Fikr-mulohazani faqat xato paytida emas, muntazam so‘rang. Aniq savol va kichik o‘zgarish jamoaning o‘sishini tezlashtiradi.
fields.content_en: Ask for feedback regularly, not only after mistakes. A precise question and a small adjustment help teams improve faster.

fields.title_en: Create one visible result each semester
fields.content_uz: Har semestr loyiha, tadqiqot yoki amaliy hisobot kabi ko‘rsatish mumkin bo‘lgan bitta sifatli natija yarating.
fields.content_en: Each semester, create one strong piece of visible work: a project, research note or well-documented practical report.
